scope_contract.goal_statement: Capture the details of MSIU Salesman.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The VMU User captures the details of one MSIU salesperson, completing that salesperson's registration.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The VMU User is ready to register an MSIU salesperson.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The MSIU salesperson's details have been captured in the system.

excluded_adjacent_actions: Using the captured details to analyze or understand salesperson or team performance.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User is a member of the Admin Team and has access to the 'MSIU Sales Team Information Master' module.
A separate Sales-team master has already been established, because salesperson details include a reference to a Sales-team maintained in that master.

missing_aspects: System state requirements before starting registration
Existence of prerequisite data (e.g., Distributor setup)

The specific authorization to capture salesperson details is not explicitly stated in the cited cards; they confirm the user's role (Admin Team) and access to the module, but not the specific permission level for data entry.

claims.content: The VMU User selects the 'MSIU Sales Team Information Master' module to begin capturing salesperson details.
The VMU User captures the details of the MSIU salesperson in the selected module.
The system captures the MSIU salesperson's details, including a reference to the Sales-team which will have a separate master.

The system checks the entered Salesman Code and Sales-team ID for duplicates, preventing registration on a duplicate ID. If a duplicate name is captured, the system displays a warning message allowing the user to keep the duplicate name or change it.
Diverges from Step 2 when the captured salesperson name duplicates an existing name: the system displays a warning that allows the duplicate name to be kept or the name to be changed.
At step 2, if the VMU User enters a duplicate salesman or team ID while capturing salesperson details, the system checks for the duplicate ID and prevents the registration.

At step 2, if a duplicate name is captured for the salesman or team, the system displays a warning message allowing the user to either keep the duplicate name or change it. If the user chooses to keep the duplicate name (Yes), the system allows the same name to be entered and the registration to proceed; if the user chooses not to keep it (No), the system does not allow the new entry to be saved.
The MSIU salesperson's details have been captured in the system and stored in the Database within the MSIU Sales Team Information Master module.

The captured salesperson record contains Salesman Code, Name of the Salesman, DOB & Age, Gender, Communication Address, Contact No, E-Mail Id, and a reference to a Sales-team maintained in a separate master.
The system has checked the Salesman Code and referenced Sales-team ID for duplicates; if a duplicate was found, a warning message was issued allowing the user to keep the duplicate name or change it.

inconsistency_hints: Main Flow does not describe the system checking Salesman Code/Sales-team ID for duplicates or the warning/keep-or-change handling, yet Postcondition 3 asserts that check and possible warning as an outcome.

Alternative flow claim 0 attaches to main_flow Step 2, which is about capturing MSIU salesperson details, but the branch condition concerns a duplicate Distributor name. Distributor name is not part of the salesperson registration step described in main_flow, so the attachment point is logically unrelated even though Step 2 exists.

Exception flow claim 1 says the duplicate-name warning lets the user keep or change the name, but it does not document the outcome for either branch. There is no clear return to a main_flow step, termination/handoff, or terminal failure/prevention state after the user chooses to keep or change the duplicate name.
